MEASURED, do not re-derive. In a `git archive HEAD` materialization with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `tsc -p tests/security/tsconfig.json` (the first half of `pnpm test:security`, package.json:26) exits 1 at `tests/security/runtime-provider-projects.security.ts(107,32) TS2339: Property 'openTicket' does not exist on type 'ProjectRuntimeSession'` and `(129,5) TS2322: 'approvePairing' is missing … in ProjectStackDaemonHandle`. The tracked runtime renamed the operation: HEAD:apps/daemon/src/projects/project-runtime-session.ts:90 is `approvePairing(confirmationLabel)` and HEAD:project-stack-host.ts:28 declares `approvePairing` on ProjectStackDaemonHandle; the suite at HEAD:107 still calls `session.openTicket(requestId)` and its handle fixture at :129 lacks `approvePairing`. Because tsc fails, the `&& vitest run` half of `pnpm test:security` never executes on a clean checkout — the whole security roster is silently un-run.

THE FIX ALREADY EXISTS AS UNOWNED DIRTY WIP: `tests/security/runtime-provider-projects.security.ts` is ` M` (numstat 9/13) and its diff replaces `session.openTicket(requestId)` with `session.approvePairing(confirmationLabel)` and adds `approvePairing: () => Object.freeze({ ok: true as const, state: \"APPROVED\" as const })` to the handle fixture. No live row names the file. Adopt that hunk after auditing that the 9/13 diff contains nothing else; if it does, stage MODE 2 with only these hunks.

After this row, the remaining clean-checkout red in tests/security is `project-transport-hostile-cases.ts:6` importing the not-yet-tracked Control Room client (child task-0602f6c2, P1.2b-ii) — disclosed, not this row's.
